children: Payone filed a definitive proxy and will hold a Sept. 14, 2026 special meeting to vote on the proposed merger with Nuvei Parent, and is supplementing the proxy amid related litigation.
Special meeting set for Sept. 14, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. ET for stockholder vote on the merger with Nuvei Parent.
Two shareholder lawsuits filed alleging the proxy statement is materially incomplete and seeking to enjoin the merger.
Company received demand letters seeking corrective disclosures or books and records; Payone believes claims are without merit.
Payone will voluntarily supplement the proxy statement to moot disclosure claims and reduce litigation risk and costs.
